Research assessment

No executable association-only discriminator survives inside the current EGRCR-B1 scientific object. The smallest answer-changing discriminator is already static: an identity-support and oracle-headroom certificate. That certificate fails decisively.

This does not mean that the intact counterfactual target has no effect. It measurably changes request probabilities. Nor does it establish that association-specific credit is generally useless. It means that this exact two-agent host cannot distinguish physical waiter association from generic type/cue supervision, and its scarce-allocation evaluator cannot convert the observed intact-versus-GAE probability difference into a different decision.

The direction’s recorded position—expressibility and selectivity passed while utility and allocation improvement were zero—is accurate, but the repository permits a sharper interpretation: the host lacks the physical identity support required to make that null an association test.

1. The bounded consequence is independent of waiter identity

Opportunity stores older_id, and the actor can indirectly infer it because joiner_id = 1 - older_id. But the physical consequence function _world never reads older_id, joiner_id, the event key, or cue state. Once kind, lag, and the immediate-execution indicators u,v are fixed, every reward, deployment generation, packet success, and four-world outcome is fixed.

Direct algebra from the frozen host gives:

Latent type	Lag 1 κ	Lag 2 κ	Dependence on older_id
JOINT	+1/6	+1/5	None
SOLO	−1/6	−1/5	None

Their balanced average is exactly the retained calibration result: mean κ=+0.183333… for JOINT and −0.183333… for SOLO.

Consequently:

At fixed type and lag, swapping physical waiter IDs changes no four-world outcome and no κ.

At fixed later joiner identity in a two-agent system, there is not even a second possible physical waiter identity.

The reported “useful variation” in κ is entirely variation over type and lag, not over waiter identity.

A same-type, same-lag physical-identity packet swap would be numerically a no-op before any optimizer is involved.

The source-to-target and downstream-exposure gates establish that the role called W executes and affects utility. They do not establish that which physical agent occupies W matters. This is missing downstream identity exposure, not a weak identity effect.

2. The registered cut is an opposite-type sign reversal, not a wrong-identity cut

The implemented cut groups edges by a stratum that already includes older_id, lag, action, and propensity. Inside that group it explicitly maps JOINT events to shifted SOLO events and vice versa. Therefore, it preserves physical waiter identity while changing latent type.

Because the balanced stratum center is zero and opposite types have equal-magnitude, opposite-sign κ at each lag, the implemented transformation is algebraically:

The science card accurately says that the cut preserves global signed-label and action-conditioned-advantage multisets, but it also specifies that cue sign is excluded from the matching stratum and that the rotation is opposite-type. Marginal preservation therefore does not preserve the conditional relationship between the actor’s input cue and its target.

Since the joiner cue indicates JOINT versus SOLO with accuracy 0.90625, the cut reverses the dominant cue-to-consequence sign. It is therefore a strong generic-cue anti-supervision control. Changing the event key does not make it a physical-waiter identity intervention.

The trace behaves exactly as that account predicts. At root 17:

score–cue-credit covariance was −0.005050 for the cut, versus +0.005426 for GAE and +0.006823 for intact;

request selectivity was −0.014074 for the cut, versus +0.015112 for GAE and +0.018959 for intact;

the cut allocated only 10 of 128 scarce tokens to JOINT, while GAE and intact both allocated 114.

Thus INTACT > BINDING-CUT, including its disappearance under suffix yoking, is well explained by correct type/cue supervision beating sign-reversed type/cue supervision. It is not evidence that a correctly named physical waiter was distinguished from another consequence-distinct waiter.

3. The intact-versus-GAE utility null is produced by rank saturation

The fixed-token evaluator forms each dyad from one JOINT and one SOLO opportunity with the same lag, older_id, repetition coordinate, source agent, time, pending state, and every non-cue feature. The policy assigns the single token to the larger request probability.

For each dyad, therefore,

Every other actor feature cancels. As a result:

If two arms have the same sign of the cue coefficient, they make exactly the same decision on every unequal-cue dyad.

If the two cues are equal, both arms face an exact tie and use the same seed-fixed tie choice.

Increasing the magnitude of cue selectivity cannot change scarce allocation unless the coefficient crosses zero.

This is not sigmoid saturation: the recorded probabilities are around 0.69–0.72, clipping is zero, and the updates are measurably different. It is argmax/rank saturation caused by a one-dimensional matched dyad.

That explains the otherwise striking combination in the retained result:

intact improves probability selectivity over GAE by 0.004711, with a wholly positive 95% interval;

the common-uniform panel detects corresponding changes in realized Bernoulli requests;

yet intact and GAE have exactly equal fixed-token utility at all twelve roots, in both native and yoked contexts: D_IG_N=D_IG_Y=Psi_G=0.

The common-uniform panel is probability-sensitive because it thresholds each opportunity independently. It is not the scarce one-token allocator. It can therefore certify that a probability changed without showing that the change altered the investment-relevant allocation.

The intact-versus-GAE null should consequently not be read as “the estimators produced identical policies.” They did not. It should be read as “the evaluator maps both distinct policies into the same ranking class.”

4. Generic counterfactual shaping is sufficient to explain the surviving signal

Ordinary GAE receives the realized interaction atom only on sampled requests. Intact removes that atom and inserts an action-conditioned, centered four-world label for both actions:

c(a−p)
κ
.

A sampled no-request therefore receives counterfactual supervision that ordinary realized-return GAE does not receive in the same direct form. This can strengthen cue-gradient covariance, reduce dilution by unrelated return components, or act as denser two-action supervision without carrying any physical identity information. The science card itself identifies dense or lower-variance favorable-context shaping as the strongest alternative explanation.

The matched update norm, work count, global label multiset, and absence of clipping rule out several crude explanations. They do not rule out this one, because the scientifically relevant conditional association—label given the actor’s cue—is deliberately preserved by intact and reversed by the cut.

The mechanism accounting is therefore:

Association-specific physical information: absent.

Generic dense or lower-variance shaping: consistent with all observations.

Request-rate/probability geometry: directly observed in the common-uniform panel.

Opposite-type cue anti-supervision: strongly supported by the cut construction and trace.

Missing identity consequence exposure: exact from the host equations.

Evaluator saturation: exact at the fixed-token ranking boundary.

5. The smallest surviving discriminator

The most promising surviving discriminator is not another B1 execution. It is the following static certificate:

Hold type, cue sign, action, lag, propensity, readiness, budget, prepared options, information, and boundary fixed.

Substitute older_id=0 and older_id=1.

Compare all four Y^{uv} worlds and κ.

Examine whether a same-type identity permutation changes any later-record advantage.

Derive the best possible fixed-token decision available from the actor’s information and compare its ranking class with ordinary GAE.

For EGRCR-B1, the answers are already fixed:

all identity contrasts in Y and κ are exactly zero;

a same-type identity cut inserts identical packets;

the best same-information ranking uses the noisy type cue;

once GAE and intact share that cue ordering, the exact counterfactual oracle has no further scarce-allocation headroom.

This certificate could change a bounded investment decision: it supports no repeat, no larger root panel, and no attempt to “repair” the current cut inside the same host. Those activities cannot create the missing identity contrast. EGRCR-B1 can remain evidence about generic one-step counterfactual shaping, but it is exhausted as a physical waiter-association discriminator.

6. Minimum scientifically distinct evidence for reentry

Reentry requires a different scientific object, not another control in this one. The smallest credible construction is a fixed-population, at-least-three-agent host—not a variable-N claim—in which a fixed later joiner can be paired with either of two possible older waiter identities.

Before any relay comparison, disjoint construction evidence must establish all three premises:

Identity support. Under one fixed generic type, cue sign, action, lag, propensity, readiness, budget, prepared-option class, and information stratum,

with the difference arising from the pair association rather than generic quality of W_0 or W_1. A cyclic or crossover compatibility design should balance each physical identity’s marginal value across joiners so that “agent 0 is simply better” is not sufficient.

Same-information oracle headroom. An identity-aware oracle using only information available to every learning arm must change actual one-token allocation or bounded utility relative to ordinary GAE by a prospectively material margin. A probability or logit difference alone is insufficient. If ordinary GAE already occupies the oracle ranking class, the association experiment should stop before treatment.

A legal identity-only cut. Within exact type, cue sign, action, lag, propensity, and nuisance strata, use a fixed-point-free permutation that changes only the waiter identity whose pair-specific packet is attached to the source record. It must preserve cue-conditioned target marginals, individual-identity marginals, update scale, source observations, suffixes, token counts, and work. It must never swap JOINT with SOLO.

Only then is the single intervention interpretable:

INTACT-ID: attach κ(J,W_actual);

IDENTITY-CUT: attach κ(J,W_other) under the matched identity permutation.

Under a genuine association mechanism, intact should improve native scarce allocation and utility over the identity cut, and that difference should disappear when the physical pair association is independently yoked. Generic dense shaping predicts equality because the target distributions and cue relationship remain fixed. Generic-cue anti-supervision also predicts equality because cue supervision is no longer reversed.

The association account would be falsified if, despite proven consequence-distinct identities and positive oracle headroom, correct and identity-cut binding produced the same scarce allocation and utility; if the benefit persisted after association yoking; or if separation appeared only in probability magnitude or request count.

Strongest evidence against this conclusion

The strongest contrary evidence is real: all registered expression and exposure gates passed; intact improved native probability selectivity over both comparators; it beat the cut substantially on native utility; the cut contrast largely disappeared under yoking; and work, displacement, counts, and global label distributions were controlled.

That evidence demonstrates that the exact counterfactual replacement changes learning and that attaching a type-aligned packet is better than attaching an opposite-type packet. It leaves open the possibility that a probability-sensitive evaluator would convert the small intact-versus-GAE selectivity difference into expected utility.

It does not overcome the decisive limitation: no physical waiter identity affects the consequence, no fixed joiner has two candidate waiters, and the implemented cut never changes older_id. A softer evaluator could support a claim about generic counterfactual shaping, but it could not manufacture an association-specific claim.

Claim ceiling

The maximum supported claim at this commit is:

In this finite two-agent, one-update versioned-handoff host, replacing a realized GAE interaction atom with an exact action-conditioned counterfactual interaction label modestly strengthened type-cue request selectivity relative to ordinary GAE and avoided the severe harm of an opposite-type label permutation, but it did not improve fixed-token scarce allocation or bounded utility over GAE.

The strongest remaining alternative is generic dense or lower-variance cue supervision combined with a rank-insensitive evaluator.

No conclusion follows about variable numbers of agents, fixed-k superiority, multiple updates, learned estimators, continuous control, UAV value, safety, or general source-to-target credit. The static result retires this exact host for physical waiter-association identification; it does not retire the broader mechanism.
